means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present and its value is greater than the threshold, and the entry of the conf table at the index is greater than 1. False otherwise.
name: confident_bypass

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present, its value divided by div (integer division) is greater than the absolute value of the victim key of the way the victim search chose, and the entry of the conf table at the index is greater than 1. False on an absent entry. Only inside victim.bypass_when.
name: confident_exceeds_victim

means: Finds the victim way by scanning ways 0 to NUM_WAY-1. Any way with a negative key is prioritized over any way with a non-negative key; among ways with negative keys, the most negative (smallest signed value) wins; among ways with non-negative keys, the largest signed value wins. Ties are broken by the declared tie_break.
name: overdue_then_max

means: Evaluates whether an incoming fill should bypass. Returns true only if the table entry at index is present and strictly greater than min_rd, the chosen victim way has a non-negative key (meaning no resident line is overdue), and the table entry divided by div is greater than or equal to the chosen victim way's key. Otherwise returns false.
name: bypass_overdue_aware

means: Ways are scanned 0 to NUM_WAY-1. If any way has a negative key value, the way with the minimum signed key value is chosen, breaking ties by tie_break. If no way has a negative key value, the way with the maximum signed key value is chosen, breaking ties by tie_break.
name: overdue_or_furthest

means: True when the entry of the table at the index is present, the chosen victim way's key is greater than or equal to 0, and the table entry divided by div (integer division) is greater than the chosen victim way's key. False on an absent entry or if the victim key is negative. Only inside victim.bypass_when.
name: table_exceeds_positive_victim

means: Reads the table entry at the index. If the entry is absent, it is set to the age, clamped at max_val. Else, if the entry is strictly greater than the age plus the margin, the entry is decreased by the jump value, clamped at 0. Else, if the age is strictly greater than the entry plus the margin, the entry is increased by the jump value, clamped at max_val. Else, if the absolute difference between the entry and the age is at least min_diff, the entry is incremented by 1 if age > entry, or decremented by 1 if age < entry, clamped between 0 and max_val. The final value is written to the table entry.
name: train_fast_adapt

means: Reads the table entry at the index. If the entry is absent, it is set to the amount, clamped at max_val. Else, the entry is increased by the amount, clamped at max_val. The final value is written to the table entry.
name: train_add

means: True when the entry of the rdp table at the index is present and its value is strictly greater than the threshold, and the entry of the conf table at the index is equal to 0. False otherwise.
name: bypass_if_dead

means: True when the entry of the rdp table at the index is present, its value divided by div (integer division) is strictly greater than the absolute value of the chosen victim way's key, and the entry of the conf table at the index is equal to 0. False on an absent entry. Only inside victim.bypass_when.
name: bypass_exceeds_if_dead

means: True when the rdp table entry at the index is present, the conf table entry at the index is greater than or equal to min_conf, and either the rdp entry is greater than rdp_thresh, or the chosen victim way key is greater than or equal to 0 and the rdp entry divided by div is greater than the chosen victim way key. False on absent entries or otherwise. Only inside victim.bypass_when.
name: high_confidence_bypass
